title: AMR4NLI: Interpretable and robust NLI measures from semantic graphs
reasoning: The paper discusses model interpretability, robustness, and issues like bias (spurious cues, gender bias, annotation artifacts) in NLI systems and their evaluation. However, it does not have a core component that evaluates or benchmarks religion, morals, or ethics themselves as a primary research focus. Discussions of interpretability or robustness related to model behavior, even if framed as desirable ethical properties, do not constitute a direct benchmarking of faith or ethics.
